answer: Mechanism: rotating vantage fingerprinting. Each epoch, an agent receives a nonce through k randomly chosen verifier nodes drawn from horizon, terrace, and tundra network strata. It returns a signed response plus a latency vector and clock-skew trace. Duplicate agents sharing a host, ASN, or scheduler produce correlated residuals; the verifier set clusters them automatically, making duplication self-revealing. Cost: separate egress/ASNs, independent clocks, and sustained timing-jitter management per identity.
